page.notes: Long s in the source is read as a plain s throughout. "sæ-pe" is read from a ligature-like form and is doubtful. The page number "320" is clear but its last digit is set in an old-style form. The fragment "tem" at the top is the end of a word begun on the previous page. Two lines are set in one small ligature form in "sententiam" and "Re-ctè", read with some doubt. A small stray mark at the bottom right is not printed text and is left out.
